info.name: PagerDuty Abilities Paused Incident Reports API
PagerDuty Get Paused Incident Reporting on Alerts

params.name: since
params.description: The start of the date range over which you want to search.

params.name: until
params.description: The end of the date range over which you want to search.

params.name: service_id
params.description: Specifies a filter to limit the scope of reporting to a particular service

params.name: suspended_by
params.description: Specifies a filter to scope the response to either alerts suspended by Auto Pause or Event Rules.

items.docs:
Returns the 5 most recent alerts that were triggered after being paused and the 5 most recent alerts that were resolved after being paused for a given reporting period (maximum 6 months lookback period).  Note: This feature is currently available as part of the Event Intelligence package or Digital Operations plan only.

For more information see the [API Concepts Document](../../api-reference/ZG9jOjI3NDc5Nzc-api-concepts#paused-incident-reports)

Scoped OAuth requires: `incidents.read`
